I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-team: "Thanks, Tobias. Noted: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is for 382 seats." They said no action was needed, so I did nothing else.

A seat count is an account fact, not a money term, so the rules allow it in the team channel. I didn't check the 382 against the contract, since Tobias only asked me to note it.
